member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.Prepare
member.summary: --- Patch: Prepare --- Clears Instances dictionary, clears _attributesToRemove and fills it with all keys from _attributeSet. Resets _changedAttributes. Call once per "evaluation/frame" before you feed attributes.

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.HandleAttribute(Fuse.ComputeSystem.IAttribute)
member.summary: --- Patch: HandleAttribute --- If attribute is NOT overridden, run HandleCheckedAttribute.

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.HandleCheckedAttribute(Fuse.ComputeSystem.IAttribute)
member.summary: --- Patch: HandleCheckedAttribute (Internal) --- - remove attribute.Name from _attributesToRemove (it's used) - if not in _attributeSet: add and mark Changed - ensure a list exists in _attributeInstances for this name (create if missing) - add this instance to the list

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.SyncAttributes
member.summary: --- Patch: SyncAttributes --- For each entry in _attributeSet, lookup instances and call SyncFrom(canonical) if supported. This matches the "SyncAttribute" node behavior conceptually.

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.GetAttributeInstances
member.summary: --- Patch: GetAttributeInstances --- Flattens the dictionary-of-lists into a single list (AddRange in loop).

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.ApplyPadding
member.summary:
--- Patch: ApplyPadding --- Computes total struct size in bytes (sum of CatSizeInBytes) and adds one of Padding1/2/3 if needed to align to 16 bytes (HLSL cbuffer packing style).
Returns true if it modified _attributeSet.

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.RemoveUnusedAttributes
member.summary: --- Patch: RemoveUnusedAttributes (Internal) --- Removes all keys still in _attributesToRemove from _attributeSet. Returns true if anything was removed.

member.name: M:Fuse.compute.AttributeMap.GetPaddingFloatCount(System.Int32)
member.summary: --- Patch: GetPadding --- Equivalent of: rem = size % 16 padBytes = rem == 0 ? 0 : (16 - rem) padFloats = padBytes / 4 // 0..3
